user.title: SmartPID M5 PRO
user.description: Enter the 14-character device ID — the hash from the MQTT topics, i.e. the 14 characters right after `smartpidM5/pro/` (e.g. a1b2c3d4e5f6a7).

error.invalid_id: The device ID must be exactly 14 hexadecimal characters (0-9, a-f).
